title: Claude queues — attachment timing in the first test build

steps.path: Claude chat, while a reply is running
steps.headline: Can file-bearing messages wait for the reply to finish in the first test build?
steps.today: You chose native-style delivery between action batches. Short text passed that test; longer text also worked after exact composer verification. The native queue UI will be reused.
steps.problem: Attachment-path messages did not pass the same held-boundary test. One reached Claude only after the original turn ended. Mid-task @file text arrived without the file contents.
steps.proposal: For the first test build, deliver plain text between actions; keep attachments and @file messages in the app-owned queue until Claude is idle. Preserve their files and edit/remove controls. Stop, Clear and paused restore keep your approved behavior. This changes only file-bearing delivery timing, not the UI layout.

options.label: Test text queues first
pros: Gets a useful test build without pretending file delivery is equivalent.
cons: Files wait for the reply to finish; a file at the front also holds later queued messages.

options.label: Prove all input types first
pros: Keeps the original timing target for both text and files.
cons: Delays the test build; Claude may not expose the needed behavior safely.
